page_title: CLE 1-1 MNT | Clermont v Montpellier 14/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+6' The corner by Johan Gastien (Clermont) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power. The ball goes out of play and Montpellier will have a goal kick.
90+3' Chrislain Matsima (Clermont) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Thomas Leonard didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.

90+2' What a chance that is! Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a pass on the edge of the box. His attempt goes just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Clermont will have a goal kick.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Kiki Kouyate (Montpellier) comes onto the pitch so that Arnaud Nordin can be given a rest.
89' Yohan Magnin is substituted due to injury. Pascal Gastien gives a chance to Shamar Nicholson (Clermont).
85' Jordan Ferri (Montpellier) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Thomas Leonard blows his whistle for a foul. Clermont have a free kick.
82' The resulting set piece from Clermont is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
81' Yann Karamoh (Montpellier) is caught offside by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
79' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Muhammed Cham as he is replaced by Bilal Boutobba (Clermont).
78' That will be all from Elbasan Rashani who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Jeremie Bela (Clermont).
78' Here is a change. Teji Savanier is going off and Michel Der Zakarian gives the last tactical orders to Leo Leroy (Montpellier).
77' Here comes a substitution. Yann Karamoh (Montpellier) is brought on as a substitute for Akor Adams.
74' Akor Adams (Montpellier) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
72' Elbasan Rashani (Clermont) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
71' Elbasan Rashani (Clermont) fouls an opponent during an attacking move. A free kick is awarded to Montpellier.
67' Pascal Gastien has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Grejohn Kyei (Clermont) replacing Alan Virginius.
65' The referee blows for a cooling break.
65' Substitution. Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) has come on for Tanguy Coulibaly.
64' A pass by Mehdi Zeffane (Clermont) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
63' Mehdi Zeffane (Clermont) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
58' Thomas Leonard shows the yellow card to Tanguy Coulibaly (Montpellier) for a heavy challenge.
58' Here comes the VAR decision. The goal is given and Montpellier players have a reason to celebrate!
57' The Montpellier players halt their celebrations as referee Thomas Leonard makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
56' 1 - 1 Goal! Tanguy Coulibaly (Montpellier) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the left post. It's 1:1.
51' Muhammed Cham (Clermont) prepares to take a corner kick.
50' Surely that's handball by one of the Montpellier players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!

49' Akor Adams (Montpellier) latched on to a fine cross from the corner kick on the edge of the box. His shot, however, flies narrowly over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Clermont will have a goal kick.
49' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
48' A pass by Muhammed Cham (Clermont) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+6' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' 1 - 0 Goal! Benjamin Lecomte gets a hand on the penalty from Muhammed Cham (Clermont), but can't stop it from flying into the bottom right corner.
45+4' The ref indicates that Muhammed Cham (Clermont) must retake the penalty!
45+3' Muhammed Cham (Clermont) wastes a huge opportunity to score from the penalty spot. He attempts to slot into the bottom left corner, but Benjamin Lecomte pulls off a superb save.
45+3' Muhammed Cham (Clermont) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.

45+2' Jordan Ferri (Montpellier) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle. PENALTY to Clermont! Let's see who will take responsibility.

45+1' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Clermont, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
45+1' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
44' Mory Diaw leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Teji Savanier (Montpellier).
44' The goalkeeper punched the ball away after Teji Savanier (Montpellier) took the corner. Montpellier win a corner.

43' Arnaud Nordin (Montpellier) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the top left corner. Mory Diaw has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Montpellier.
41' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) crosses the ball from the free kick, but it goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Clermont.
41' Thomas Leonard blows his whistle. Elbasan Rashani (Clermont) commits a foul after dangerous play. Montpellier are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
38' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
35' Alan Virginius (Clermont) is penalised for a foul. Thomas Leonard had a clear view and blows his whistle. A free kick has been awarded to Montpellier.
32' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) picks up a pass and hits the ball towards goal, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Mory Diaw.
29' PENALTY APPEAL after Jordan Ferri (Montpellier) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
27' Habib Keita (Clermont) commits a rough challenge and Thomas Leonard blows his whistle for a foul.
25' Akor Adams (Montpellier) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Mory Diaw makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the right side of the goal.
23' A cooling break is underway.
22' Flag up against Chrislain Matsima (Clermont). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
21' Jordan Ferri (Montpellier) trips an opposition player and Thomas Leonard signals a foul. That's a free kick to Clermont.
19' Neto Borges (Clermont) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
17' Muhammed Cham (Clermont) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Thomas Leonard signals. Montpellier will take a free kick near the side line.
15' Akor Adams (Montpellier) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.

14' Teji Savanier drives to the by-line and dinks a lovely cross into the middle of the box. Tanguy Coulibaly (Montpellier) wins the ball but his header is just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Clermont will have a goal kick.
12' Joris Chotard (Montpellier) rises high on the edge of the box to meet a cross and plants a powerful header goalwards, but Mory Diaw is alert and makes a decent save to deny him.
12' The Montpellier players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
6' Lucas Mincarelli (Montpellier) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Mory Diaw, who smothers the ball.
5' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Clermont.
1' The first half has started.
Montpellier will kick the game off.
Thomas Leonard got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
